annotation_definition.distance: Minimum Euclidean distance between heavy atoms in original coordinates, in Angstroms
annotation_definition.interpretation: Descriptive geometric flags only; not a calibrated confidence or interface label

terminal_handling.all_fragment_n: Use current-residue-dependent ACE (non-PRO) or ACP (PRO), consistently in VMD and CHARMM
terminal_handling.all_fragment_c: Use CT2, consistently in VMD and CHARMM
terminal_handling.outer_termini: All seven observed fragments have both ends truncated relative to validated SEQRES; none of the fourteen termini are biological termini
terminal_handling.limitations: No missing loops are rebuilt. Neutral caps are an approximation and may introduce local steric effects. Check caps and topology after building each endpoint mutant.
